text: I find myself immersed in a space that feels both open and meticulously designed, its glass walls reflecting the sharp geometry of modern thought. The display of 'R+D' pulls my attention—here, the concepts of research and development are woven visually into the fabric of the environment. I sense curiosity and excitement, standing on the edge of innovation. There is a quiet anticipation in the air, as if ideas are waiting to be shared and discussed in this thoughtful setting.
